title: Battles of Khalkhin Gol
summary: A border war between Soviet and Japanese forces in Mongolia, fought May to September 1939 beside the Khalkhin Gol river over the precise location of the frontier. After Japanese attacks stalled, General Zhukov launched a double-envelopment attack on 20 August 1939. It is also called the Nomonhan Incident.

uncertainty.note: Sources give the span only as May to September 1939; day-level start not confirmed.

where.modern_name: Khalkhin Gol area, Dornod Province, Mongolia
where.historical_name: Khalkhin Gol area, on the disputed border between the Mongolian People's Republic and Manchukuo

importance.justification: Largest clash of the 1939 Soviet-Japanese border fighting, ending in a Soviet victory that steered Japanese ambitions elsewhere.
